statement.zh: **标准**：XTS 存储加密模式（The XTS-AES Mode for Confidentiality on Storage Devices）。摘要写明本文件的动作是引用批准：「This publication approves the XTS-AES mode of the AES algorithm by reference to IEEE Std 1619-2007, subject to one additional requirement, as an option for protecting the confidentiality of data on storage devices.」同一摘要立刻减一项服务：「The mode does not provide authentication of the data or its source.」§1 交代系列位置：「This publication is the fifth Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers.」即本文件不重述算法步骤，规定对象是外部标准之上的一个附加要求与其适用性。
statement.en: **Standard**: The XTS-AES Mode for Confidentiality on Storage Devices (XTS 存储加密模式).The abstract states the act of approval: "This publication approves the XTS-AES mode of the AES algorithm by reference to IEEE Std 1619-2007, subject to one additional requirement, as an option for protecting the confidentiality of data on storage devices." The next sentence subtracts a service: "The mode does not provide authentication of the data or its source." Clause 1 places the part in the series: "This publication is the fifth Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers.

statement.zh: 对象来自另一标准：§3 写「The Security in Storage Working Group (SISWG) of the P1619 Task Group of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc (IEEE) developed and specified XTS-AES in IEEE Std.1619-2007 [2].」本文件要补的是把该构造收进 NIST 的批准清单并限定场景：「The XTS-AES mode was designed for the cryptographic protection of data on storage devices that use of fixed length “data units,” as defined in Ref.[2].」设计来源则追溯到外部工作：「The XTS-AES mode is an instantiation of Rogaway’s XEX (XOR Encrypt XOR) tweakable block cipher」。即本文件自陈的立场是引用外部标准加以批准，并声明该模式面向存储而非通用加密。
statement.en: The object comes from another standard body: §3 records "The Security in Storage Working Group (SISWG) of the P1619 Task Group of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc (IEEE) developed and specified XTS-AES in IEEE Std.1619-2007 [2]." What this Recommendation adds is incorporation into an approved list with the setting fixed: "The XTS-AES mode was designed for the cryptographic protection of data on storage devices that use of fixed length “data units,” as defined in Ref.

statement.zh: 唯一的附加要求写成 shall 级，落在实现方：§4「The length of the data unit for any instance of an implementation of XTS-AES shall not exceed 220 AES blocks.」（220 同样是丢了上标的 2 的 20 次方）同段立刻标明该限的来源与强制程度差别：「Note that Subclause 5.1 of Ref.[2] recommends this limit but does not require it.」符合性的定义是条件式的：「An implementation of the XTS-AES encryption mode may claim conformance with this Recommendation if every supported instance satisfies this length requirement for a data unit, in addition to all of the requirements in Clauses 1-6 of Ref.[2].
statement.en: The single additional requirement is a shall addressed to the implementation: §4 states "The length of the data unit for any instance of an implementation of XTS-AES shall not exceed 220 AES blocks." (this 220 is likewise 2 to the power 20 with the superscript lost in extraction) and immediately marks the difference in obligation level: "Note that Subclause 5.1 of Ref.[2] recommends this limit but does not require it.

statement.zh: 限度一是服务本身：§3「Authentication is not provided, because the P1619 Task Group designed XTS-AES to provide encryption without data expansion, so alternative cryptographic methods that incorporate an authentication tag are precluded.」限度二是场景：§3「The XTS-AES mode was not designed for other purposes, such as the encryption of data in transit.」限度三是物理位置由实现自定：§5「Subclause 5.1 of [2] indicates that an implementation of XTS-AES should include a mapping between the pairs of indices that define the blocks (and possibly a single partial block) of a data unit and their physical location in the storage device, but that the mapping itself is outside the scope of the standard.
statement.en: The first limit is the missing service: §3 states "Authentication is not provided, because the P1619 Task Group designed XTS-AES to provide encryption without data expansion, so alternative cryptographic methods that incorporate an authentication tag are precluded." The second is the setting: "The XTS-AES mode was not designed for other purposes, such as the encryption of data in transit." The third leaves placement to the implementation: "Subclause 5.

statement.zh: 页眉首行给出编号与日期「NIST Special Publication 800-38E January, 2010」，扉页日期行为 January 2010，作者栏 Morris Dworkin；引用行是「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38E, 9 pages (January 2010) CODEN: NSPUE2」，本份文本无 DOI 行。致谢页点名外部工作组与评审同事：「The author wishes to thank Matt Ball, the Chair of the Security in Storage Working Group of the IEEE P1619 Task Group, as well as the author’s colleagues who reviewed drafts of this publication and contributed to its development, especially Elaine Barker, Lily Chen, John Kelsey, Tim Polk, Bill Burr, and Sharon Keller.」附录 A 的书目给出被引用的标准及其日期：「IEEE Std 1619-2007, The XTS-AES Tweakable Block Cipher, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Inc., Apr.18, 2008.
statement.en: The running head gives number and date, "NIST Special Publication 800-38E January, 2010"; the title block is dated January 2010 with Morris Dworkin as author, and the citation line reads "Natl.Inst.
